hypothesis: Driver complete-frame idle timeout can censor an outstanding upstream request before its 300-second idle budget expires; longer waiting may reveal completion or an upstream error.
identity_rules: Fetch the experiment into a separate clean checkout at the exact published commit; do not merge it into codex/main or run install.sh.
Invoke the experiment checkout scripts/codex-builder-loop.py explicitly for every mutating CLI call; verify version --json reports that exact commit.
Keep the existing validated capture launcher, real Codex binary and capture environment. Verify their hashes and the effective Tester cwd configuration before execution.

Use official successor/supersession from vbase-passive-read-upstream-20261023, preserving source frozen runtime, attempt history and candidate implementation. Never replace an existing frozen runtime or profile digest by editing the ledger.
Preserve mission, authority, assurance and model settings; reacquire independent evidence. No deployment or release is part of this experiment.
execution_rules: Run the actual Tester workload with the capture launcher; a no-tools capability probe only admits the executable.
Verify the tester_author profile is 360/7200/600 and record its digest with runtime, action, turn and thread identities.
Use the existing generation retry limit of three, without reset or extra generations. This is one controlled successor, not a repeat-until-success loop.
Do not claim an automatic idle migration for old active runs; the experiment requires a new runtime identity.
Record the first timeout/error immediately; retain every attempt even if a later attempt succeeds. Other actions keep 120-second idle limits.
If Tester completes, use the normal independent gates for any business acceptance claim. A completed author turn alone is not business PASS.

outcomes.completion_after_120_seconds_of_driver_s: Shows longer waiting enabled completion for this attempt. Does not prove all historical failures have the same cause.
outcomes.completion_without_more_than_120_seconds: This attempt did not exercise the old idle boundary; not evidence the timeout change caused success.
outcomes.upstream_error_before_driver_deadline: Record the exact redacted error category and timing; investigate the exposed upstream failure rather than extending again.
outcomes.driver_360_second_timeout: The larger budget still produced no terminal frame. Preserve evidence and stop at the configured retry bound; do not automatically raise the deadline again.
outcomes.total_deadline: Classify separately from idle timeout; retain the original 7200-second cap.
outcomes.drift_or_capture_failure: Mark the comparison inconclusive; retain state and report the precise drift or missing evidence.

comparison_limit: Historical 120-second attempts versus fresh 360-second attempts are sequential observations, not deterministic replay or a randomized causal A/B test.
upstream_limit: 360 seconds covers one configured 300-second upstream idle interval plus 60 seconds, not every possible internal retry or server computation duration.
